name: Render Sandboxes
description: Creates ephemeral, isolated sandboxes where AI agents run untrusted code, execute commands, and transfer files, via the Render CLI or TypeScript and Python SDKs. Public beta.

skills.name: Create Sandbox
skills.description: Creates a sandbox with a chosen compute plan, runtime and idle timeouts, environment variables, and outbound network rules.

skills.name: Execute Commands
skills.description: Executes shell commands and agent-generated code inside a sandbox and streams back their output and exit code.

skills.name: File Transfer
skills.description: Uploads code and files into a sandbox and downloads the output it produces, including entire directories.

skills.name: Snapshots
skills.description: Captures a sandbox's filesystem or running processes as a snapshot and restores that state into a new sandbox.
